user_journeys.description: Navigate from the homepage to a specific wallpaper detail page through the Wallpapers category.
user_journeys.business_value: Ensures users can browse and access specific content categories and individual items.
user_journeys.user_persona: Casual browser looking for a desktop wallpaper

proposed_scenarios.scenario_name: Discovered Workflow: Unsplash Wallpaper Click - Complete User Journey
proposed_scenarios.description: Verify that a user can navigate to the Wallpapers category and select a specific wallpaper to view its details.
proposed_scenarios.workflow_narrative: The agent started on the Unsplash homepage, navigated to the 'Wallpapers' topic page using the navigation link, and then clicked on a specific wallpaper titled 'Interlocking rounded shapes' to view its full details.
playwright_implementation_guidance: Use page.goto with waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' for the initial load.
The wallpaper selection uses a role-based link selector which is robust for accessibility.
Verify navigation by checking the resulting URL patterns for '/t/wallpapers' and the specific photo ID.
proposed_scenarios.business_goal: Verify users can successfully browse and select specific wallpapers from the category pages.
proposed_scenarios.user_story: As a user, I want to browse the wallpapers category and click on an image so that I can see it in full detail and download it.

detailed_steps.description: Click on the specific wallpaper 'Interlocking rounded shapes'
detailed_steps.verification_point: URL matches the specific photo detail page
detailed_steps.business_impact: Content accessibility and detail view functionality

expected_results: User successfully navigates to the Wallpapers topic page.
User successfully opens the detail page for 'Interlocking rounded shapes'.
edge_cases_to_test: Topic page failing to load images
Clicking a wallpaper that has been removed
Slow loading of high-resolution image previews
data_requirements: No specific user account required (public browsing)
